learning.title: Drill every retry and requeue path live, with a fake that answers the harness probes
learning.trigger: A change requeues a job, adds a harness probe such as --version, or changes what a failed attempt leaves behind.
learning.mistake: Requeue tests never opened an output binding, so a retried attempt failed at output-bindings (closed stream) until a live timeout drill hit it. Proof fakes had no --version branch, so every fake run failed once the harness probed the CLI, and an older closeout proved nothing about the new candidate.
learning.rule: Give every fake executable an early --version branch before it reads stdin or its config. For each requeue path, run a live drill that reaches the second attempt and assert its output binding and run completion; add an integration case that opens the binding on both attempts. Re-run the closeout at the final code SHA and commit raw captures for every id the record names.

verification.requirement: Record the drill task and attempt ids with a committed DB capture, and the SHA the drill ran at.

learning.boundary: Applies to harness runs on ephemeral per-worktree stacks; real funded runs stay maintainer-gated.
